findings.claim: Nested node/edge detail variants and graph enums were still under-specified.
findings.resolution: FIXED: output schemas now enumerate every NodeKind, NodeRole, and EdgeKind and define closed tagged schemas for all NodeDetails and EdgeDetails variants; regressions accept valid non-null variants and reject unknown tags, fields, and enum values.

findings.claim: The rmcp wire-discovery golden discarded outputSchema and deprecation metadata.
findings.resolution: FIXED: normalized local and wire discovery now retain output-schema digests and exact metadata for all tools, and the checked-in golden pins those fields.

findings.claim: Final-envelope overflow lost the stable query_response_too_large diagnostic identifier.
findings.resolution: FIXED: the outer bound preserves query_response_too_large, and a protocol-level call_tool regression exercises the inner-pass/outer-fail case.

checked_classes: closed tagged detail schemas and enums
wire discovery output-schema and metadata contract
